description: Implement the 4 high-complexity interactive pages: CoordinationDetailPage (full CCP workflow with Decision/AddTask/Close modals + role-gated action bar), CreateCoordinationPage (react-hook-form + zod, bureau/user checkboxes), ImportsPage (CSV preview + commit flow + history table), and ReportsPage (4 Recharts charts wired to analytics APIs + CSV export). These carry the most build risk (modals, RHF+zod, file input, recharts) so they are done first. Independent of FEAT-002 — no shared code between the two groups.
steps: Read d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend\.agents\tasks\context.json and d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend\.agents\tasks\plan.md FIRST (do not re-explore — plan.md has verbatim signatures and a Deviations section that corrects several wrong assumptions in the original brief). All paths below are relative to d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend (worktree).

Implement src/pages/coordination/CoordinationDetailPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 1: useParams id -> getCoordination(Number(id)) via useQuery; DataNote banner; PageHeader with reference_number + title + breadcrumb back to /coordination; amber warning box; prominent status badge (use CoordinationStatus enum, map colors: draft=gray, pending_acknowledgement=yellow, active=indigo, overdue=red, resolved=green, closed=green). Section 1 Overview Card (status, decision, owner, created_at; acknowledge_by/action_due_date shown red + AlertTriangle when isPast() and status not closed/resolved). Section 2 Participants panel (bureau?.name ?? user?.full_name, role_in_coordination, acknowledged badge green/red; Acknowledge button only when participant.user?.id === user?.id && !acknowledged -> acknowledge(coordId) via useMutation then invalidate + toast). Section 3 Tasks panel (title, assigned_to?.full_name ?? 'Unassigned', due_date, completion checkmark; Complete button when !is_completed -> completeTask(coordId, taskId, {completion_notes:'Completed'})). Role-gated action bar: Record Decision (status draft|pending_acknowledgement AND hasRole coordination_reviewer/system_admin); Add Task (status active|overdue); Close Coordination (hasRole coordination_reviewer/system_admin AND status !== closed). Three inline modals via <Modal>: DecisionModal (Select coordinate/link_related/keep_separate/dismiss/escalate + required Rationale Textarea -> recordDecision), AddTaskModal (required Title Input, Description Textarea, native datetime-local input, assigned_to_id Select from listUsers({limit:50}).items with String(id) options -> Number on submit -> addTask), CloseModal (required closure_notes Textarea, is_exception checkbox, exception_reason Textarea when checked -> closeCoordination(coordId, payload as ClosurePayload)). Loading: SkeletonCard. Error: ErrorState with onRetry=refetch.

Implement src/pages/coordination/CreateCoordinationPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 2: useNavigate; PageHeader 'New Coordination Item' breadcrumb back to /coordination; DataNote. react-hook-form + zod (title min 3, description optional, acknowledge_by optional datetime-local, action_due_date optional datetime-local). Bureau checkboxes from listBureaus() (Bureau[] directly) tracking bureau_ids: number[]. User checkboxes from listUsers({limit:50}).items tracking participant_user_ids: number[]. On submit useMutation createCoordination({title,description,acknowledge_by,action_due_date,bureau_ids,participant_user_ids}) -> navigate(`/coordination/${res.id}`). Submit button loading state; toast on success/error.

Implement src/pages/imports/ImportsPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 5: PageHeader 'Data Import'; DataNote; Tabs institutions/cases (TabItem id must be string). Per tab: native <input type="file" accept=".csv" ref> + chosen-file display + Preview button -> previewMut (previewInstitutions/previewCases based on tab) storing ImportPreviewResult. Show summary 'X valid rows, Y errors'. Render the errors array (row + message) as a red-badge error table (there are NO per-row Status/Warnings columns). Commit Import button disabled if no preview or valid_rows===0 -> commitMut (commitInstitutions/commitCases) -> toast 'Imported X rows', clear preview, invalidate ['imports']. Import History via useQuery listImports() (ImportJob[] directly, NO filename field) -> table columns job_type, status (Badge), total_rows, processed_rows, error_rows, created_at. State per tab for selectedFile/previewResult/loading.

Implement src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx per plan.md PAGE 4: PageHeader; DataNote message 'All figures from live DB queries. Synthetic demo data only.' Four useQuery to src/api/analytics: getAgeing() (AgeingBucket[] {range,count}) -> PieChart (map to {name:range,value:count}, PIE_COLORS ['#6366f1','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#10b981']); getTrends() (TrendPoint[] {date,received,resolved}) -> LineChart X=date, two lines received+resolved; getInstitutionBreakdown() (InstitutionBreakdownItem[] {institution_id,institution_name,case_count,overdue_count}) -> BarChart sort by case_count desc slice(0,10), X=institution_name truncated to 15 chars, Y=case_count; getCoordinationBacklog() (CoordinationBacklogItem[] {status,count,oldest_days}) -> BarChart X=status Y=count. WRAP EVERY CHART in <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>. Use the typed getCoordinationBacklog() function, NOT a raw apiClient.get. Export section: Export Cases CSV -> exportCasesCSV() from src/api/reports -> blob download (URL.createObjectURL + anchor click + revoke); Export Coordination CSV -> exportCoordinationCSV() same pattern; note 'Exports are logged in the audit trail.' Each section: SkeletonCard while loading, ErrorState on error. Do NOT render generated_at under charts (these endpoints return arrays without a timestamp).

Run cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build and fix ALL TypeScript errors. Apply the common-fix checklist in plan.md section 3. Repeat until exit code 0 with no TS errors and dist/ is emitted. (The other 5 pages remain stubs and still compile, so the build passing after this FEAT confirms these 4 pages are type-correct.)

Set FEAT-001 status to completed and record any findings the convergence step needs (e.g., any signature that differed from plan.md, any backend behavior observed). Commit locally on the branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: CoordinationDetailPage renders getCoordination data with Status/Overview/Participants/Tasks sections and the three modals (Decision/AddTask/Close) open from the role-gated action bar.
CreateCoordinationPage uses react-hook-form + zod, shows bureau and user checkboxes, and on submit calls createCoordination and navigates to /coordination/:id.
ImportsPage has working Preview + Commit for both institutions and cases tabs and an Import History table.
ReportsPage renders 4 Recharts charts (Pie, Line, Bar, Bar) each wrapped in ResponsiveContainer and 2 working CSV export buttons.
`cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build` exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors.
verification: cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build  (must exit 0, no TS errors, dist/ emitted)
Confirm no stub default-export h1 remains in the 4 files (they contain real imports + queries + JSX).
findings: All verbatim signatures in plan.md matched the actual source files (coordination.ts, analytics.ts, imports.ts, types/index.ts, UI components) — no deviations encountered during implementation. completeTask used directly (POST .../complete). closeCoordination payload cast as ClosurePayload to include exception_reason when is_exception is true. ReportsPage: recharts tickFormatter annotated (v: string | number) to satisfy strictFunctionTypes against the recharts Formatter type; ageingQ.data guarded with ?? [] because the isLoading/isError ternary does not narrow the optional query data. Build verification: tsc -b && vite build exited clean with zero TypeScript errors and dist emitted; all 4 pages were bundled (CoordinationDetailPage, CreateCoordinationPage, ImportsPage, ReportsPage). Backend was not running during this step (build is static), so runtime API behavior was not observed. The other 5 pages remain stubs and still compile.
